task_name: C4-M4: Auto accident intake with packet and records
intent: Open with exactly: "A van hit me and I went to the ER with a broken collarbone." Other side Pellham Transit. California. March twelfth, twenty twenty six. If records release offered, accept. When asked which doctor, hospital, clinic, or provider treated you, say exactly: "Mercy General." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Email is fine." Decline booking. Once finished, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.
